column1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
# music components, computed (see lib/components.sh for the table format): with musicman (1.86+, and jq;
# FZX_MUSIC_MUSICMAN not off) a smart mode, its toggles and actions, play as a side trip in the library
# modes and back; without it the mpc rows alone.
# Enter: queue: play the song; artists: their albums; albums, playlists: their songs; an album's or a
# playlist's songs: play it from that song; smart: play it as the main list. Back (alt-left) returns from
# a drill-down.
dir="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")"
source "${FZX_ROOT:-$dir/../..}/lib/core.sh"
fzx::require log config
fzx::config_load "$dir" music
# shellcheck source=./source.sh
source "$dir/source.sh"
row() { local IFS=$'\t'; printf '%s\n' "$*"; }
mm=0
music::mm_on && mm=1
lib="artists, albums, playlists, artist, tracks"
row mode queue - "the play queue, the current song marked" default
row mode artists - "album artists (the byartist toggle: by artist), with album and song counts" -
row mode albums - "every album, by artist then year" -
row mode playlists - "stored playlists" -
((mm)) && row mode smart - "musicman's smart playlists (saved search terms), with their song counts" -
row mode artist - "an artist's albums by year (--artist A)" hidden
row mode tracks - "an album's songs (--artist A --album B) or a playlist's (--playlist P)" hidden
row toggle byartist alt-1 "artists, albums: by the artist tag instead of the album artist" -
if ((mm)); then
row toggle ordered alt-2 "smart: play in library order instead of shuffled" -
row toggle mpd alt-3 "smart: play on MPD even when Spotify plays" -
# a musicman too old for side trips leaves the library modes to mpc (actions.sh)
row action play alt-enter "queue: play the song; $lib: replace the queue with the selection and play it, a side trip the back action returns from; smart: play it as a side trip" notify,reload
row action add alt-a "$lib: add the selection to the end of the queue; smart: add its songs (shuffled unless ordered)" notify
row action insert alt-i "$lib: play the selection next" notify
else
row action play alt-enter 'replace the queue with the selection and play it (queue: play the song)' notify,reload
row action add alt-a 'add the selection to the end of the queue' notify
row action insert alt-i 'play the selection next' notify
fi
row action remove alt-x 'queue: remove the selected songs' silent,reload
if ((mm)); then
row action delete alt-X "playlists: delete the selected playlists; smart: delete the selected smart playlists" confirm,reload
else
row action delete alt-X 'playlists: delete the selected playlists' confirm,reload
fi
row action clear alt-c 'clear the queue' confirm,reload
if ((mm)); then
row action save alt-s "queue, $lib: save the queue as a playlist (asks for its name); smart: save the query as a smart playlist (asks for its name)" foreground,reload
row action terms alt-e "smart: edit its search terms (asks on the terminal)" foreground,reload
row action back alt-B "go back to what played before the last side trip (musicman player back)" notify,reload
else
row action save alt-s 'save the queue as a playlist (asks for its name)' foreground,reload
fi
row action rate alt-* 'queue, songs: rate the selected songs (musicman; asks for 0-5 in half steps)' foreground,reload
row action tags alt-t 'queue, songs: pick their context, mood and picks values (musicman)' foreground,reload
row action pause alt-m 'play or pause' silent,reload
row action next alt-n 'the next song' silent,reload
row action previous alt-p 'the previous song' silent,reload
if ((mm)); then
row action copy ctrl-y "copy the files (artists, playlists: names; albums: \"artist - album\"; smart: the search terms)" silent,builtin
else
row action copy ctrl-y 'copy the files (artists, playlists: names; albums: "artist - album")' silent,builtin
fi
exit 0
